name: stockyard-mcp
title: Stockyard MCP — 384 Self-Hosted Tools for AI Editors
description: Universal MCP adapter for 125 self-hosted developer tools. Feature flags, cron scheduling, webhook relay, alerting, caching, cost tracking, secrets management, and 118 more. One 7MB Go binary connects Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, or Cline to every running Stockyard tool.
